title: The Sundial Maker
description: A former watchmaker trades digital clocks for stone carving, crafting sundials that measure time by the sun.
character_reference: an older man with deeply tanned skin and powerful forearms, wearing a dusty canvas smock and leather wrist wrap

scenes.narration: Digital screens flashed numbers at me second by second, turning human time into an exhausting race against the clock.
scenes.visual: glowing digital alarm clock numbers changing rapidly in a dark room casting a harsh red light

scenes.narration: I traded microchips for river slate, choosing to measure the hours by the shifting shadows of the sun instead.
scenes.visual: heavy chisel striking a flat slab of dark gray slate stone resting on a sturdy wooden workbench

scenes.narration: Calculating the gnomon angle required precise geometry, aligning the brass blade with the axis of the earth.
scenes.visual: measuring the angle of a brass metal pin inserted into a carved stone disc using a small silver protractor

scenes.narration: Chisel taps echoed in the quiet shed as Roman numerals emerged from the rough gray stone surface.
scenes.visual: close-up of a metal chisel carving the Roman numeral twelve into the surface of a dark slate sundial

scenes.narration: When installed in the garden, the shadow moved with agonizing, beautiful slowness across the polished slate.
scenes.visual: sunlight casting a sharp shadow from a brass gnomon across carved stone markings on a garden sundial

scenes.narration: Time is not something to defeat; it is something to inhabit with patience and grace.
scenes.visual: brushing stone dust off a finished slate sundial while sitting in a tranquil, flower-filled garden

scenes.narration: Slow down and watch the right shadows fall. Follow along for more thoughtful reflections on living well.
scenes.visual: warm golden hour sunlight illuminating a hand-carved stone sundial surrounded by blooming lavender plants
